name: Open a cut from the timeline of the 12-day Rubymar replay (signed in)
description: Validates a multi-day case: the Rubymar window runs from 18 February to 2 March 2024, its three cuts sit on the timeline with their times, a cut label opens the cut's card, and Go to the close-up moves time and view and writes both into the URL.

planSteps.description: Type testsprite+clerk_test@example.com in the "Email address" field and click Continue
Wait until the code screen ("Check your email") shows "Didn't receive a code?", then type 424242; Clerk usually continues by itself after the 6th digit, so click Continue only if it is still shown

If Clerk answers "You need to send a verification code before attempting to verify", click Resend once it is enabled and type 424242 again; then wait up to 30 seconds until the URL is no longer under /sign-in
Navigate to /cases/rubymar-2024 and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state "ready"
Assert the event list (data-testid event-list) heading reads "18 February to 2 March, minute by minute" and the line under the replay clock ends with "in Sanaa"
Assert the timeline under the clock shows three cut labels, in order: "Seacom, 09:30" (data-testid timeline-cut-0), "AAE-1, 09:45" (timeline-cut-1) and "EIG, 21:00" (timeline-cut-2)
Assert a card (data-testid cut-card) titled "EIG cut" opens showing "21:00" and "UTC, 24 Feb", and the URL query has layer=cut-eig
Click "Go to the close-up" in that card

Assert the replay clock reads "21:00 UTC", the line under it starts with "25 Feb 2024, 00:00", "At the cut" is pressed in the view switch (data-testid view-switch), and the URL query has view=closeup and t=2024-02-24T21:00Z
